FACT_ID: sec13-R01 | anchor: A03
An even interstate number means an east-west route while an odd number means a north-south route [A03].
Why it matters: group route-numbering; difficulty medium; prereq sec13-F12; confusables sec13-F12, sec13-F13 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec13-R02 | anchor: A03
A three-digit interstate number starting with an even digit is a beltway or bypass around a city, while one starting with an odd digit is a spur route [A03].
Why it matters: group route-numbering; difficulty high; prereq sec13-F13; confusables sec13-F12, sec13-F13 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec13-R03 | anchor: A05
The interstate floor is fifty-five miles per hour unless conditions are bad or a lower speed is posted, the ceiling is always the legal limit, and the right lane is the place to be unless passing [A05].
Why it matters: group interstate-speed; difficulty medium; prereq sec13-F29; confusables sec13-F29, sec13-F30 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec13-R04 | anchor: A05
Braking for an exit belongs in the deceleration lane, never on the interstate itself, and the target is the posted exit ramp speed [A05].
Why it matters: group exiting; difficulty medium; prereq sec13-F25; confusables sec13-F24, sec13-F25 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec13-R05 | anchor: A05
The shoulder is for disabled vehicles only and never for parking, while the exit gore between the through lane and the ramp is a place never to stop at all [A05].
Why it matters: group stopping; difficulty medium; prereq sec13-F26; confusables sec13-F26, sec13-F27, sec13-F28 [A05]
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec13-R06 | anchor: A04
When no gap appears, the last-resort stop is on the shoulder beyond the end of the acceleration lane, never on the ramp or in the acceleration lane itself [A04].
Why it matters: group entering; difficulty high; prereq sec13-F21; confusables sec13-F21, sec13-F22 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec13-R07 | anchor: A04
Traffic already on the interstate holds the right-of-way over entering traffic, so the entering driver matches speed, merges within the lane and only afterwards changes lanes rather than cutting sharply left [A04].
Why it matters: group entering; difficulty medium; prereq sec13-F20; confusables sec13-F20, sec13-F23 [A04]
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec13-R08 | anchor: A03
A removed through lane is announced by a black and yellow panel beneath the green and white overhead guide sign, whereas an added lane is usually obvious without one [A03].
Why it matters: group guide-signs; difficulty medium; prereq sec13-F16; confusables sec13-F15, sec13-F16 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec13-R09 | anchor: A01
A mobility impaired placard or plate requires a doctor's certification on the DMV form and the plate carries a ten dollar and fifty cent transfer fee, and parking in a designated space without displaying one is illegal [A01].
Why it matters: group accessible-parking; difficulty medium; prereq sec13-F02; confusables sec13-F02, sec13-F03 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec13-R10 | anchor: A01
An accommodation request to the DMV must arrive at least forty-eight hours before the visit, and the DMV may not charge the person with a disability for the aid or modification [A01].
Why it matters: group accessibility; difficulty low; prereq sec13-F07; confusables sec13-F07, sec13-F08 [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0065]

FACT_ID: sec13-R11 | anchor: A03
Cloverleaf, diamond and trumpet are the three common interchange types, and every interchange joins two highways at different levels with connecting roads [A03].
Why it matters: group interchanges; difficulty low; prereq sec13-F17; confusables sec13-F17 [A03]
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-wv-class-e:west-virginia-division-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0067]
